{"id":"fedistract-kc30.27","title":"fieldwork owns the database schema","description":"fieldwork provides the canonical database schema, Pool enum (Postgres + SQLite behind feature flags), and migrate() function. All three projects (gaja, smallhold, broadside) use fieldwork::db::migrate(&pool) at startup. Tables that a simpler project doesn't use just sit empty.

This unblocks extracting media, cards, delivery, inbox, and discovery modules with their DB queries intact — no more per-project SQL duplication.

Subtasks:
1. Define canonical schema merging all three projects (superset of gaja+smallhold+broadside tables)
2. Implement Pool enum with Postgres/SQLite dispatch
3. Implement migrate() with idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
4. Move all shared sqlx queries into fieldwork modules (media, cards, delivery, etc.)

Key schema tables: users, personas, accounts (unify to users+personas), followers, delivery_queue, media_attachments, link_cards, post_cards, relay_subscriptions, oauth_apps, oauth_tokens, oauth_authz_codes, webauthn_credentials, push_subscriptions, posts, notifications.

Design decisions:
- users table: UUID primary key (gaja style), email, password_hash, DID fields
- personas table: UUID primary key, user_id FK, username, display_name, keys, DID fields
- smallhold 'accounts' maps to users+personas (single-user = one user, one persona)
- broadside 'personas' already matches gaja's schema closely
- SQLite uses TEXT for UUID columns
- Postgres uses native UUID type","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"epic","owner":"mark@wolfssl.com","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:20:54.854324763Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-20T02:20:54.854324763Z","labels":["extraction"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"fedistract-kc30.27","depends_on_id":"fedistract-kc30","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-20T02:20:54.870556913Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
